note: One qualifying move: Lake Ridge's school board approved a contract for an interim superintendent after its longtime leader's retirement. The other seven prospect districts had no qualifying administration news in the past 30 days.

stories.headline: Lake Ridge school board approves interim superintendent's contract
stories.body: The Lake Ridge Schools board formally approved a contract for interim superintendent Gilbert Crimmins, who has been working in the role since July 8 following the retirement of longtime superintendent Sharon Johnson-Shirley. Crimmins, a former longtime Tri-County School Corp. superintendent, will work three days a week through January while the board searches for a permanent replacement.
